lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cr2Mn4Sb2O12 (CrMn2SbO6) is monoclinic with space group C2/m (No. 12) and 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Cr and Mn centers in octahedral environments, each coordinated by six O neighbors, while Sb centers show a close-packed-like arrangement with 12 O neighbors. Corner-sharing between Cr and Mn octahedra and face-sharing between Mn octahedra and 12-vertex Sb polyhedra are observed. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites.
